instance.selection: Use target/environment mapping in owner SKILL; never enumerate unrelated profiles or silently fall back.
instance.currentVersion: unknown; historical values are not runtime evidence
instance.addressEvidence: Owner SKILL.md environment tables are the address SSOT; credential variables and exceptions in auth.nativeCredentialPath are selected-instance constraints.

auth.nativeCredentialPath: NOCODB_TOKEN in xc-token header, current session only; US nocodb.addx.live default, EU nocodb-eu.addx.live/CN nocodb-cn.addx.live only explicit request.
auth.missingCredentialWorkflow: LDAP login then avatar API Tokens; data team invites account into data_sync first. User creates token; never persist it in .env/file.
auth.subjectAndResourcePermissionVerification: Owner uses /api/v1/db/meta/projects/ and target project/tables metadata; confirms LDAP subject in UI and project membership. Modern v2/v3 endpoints require actual instance support.
auth.issuanceConsumptionRevocation: User creates/revokes API token via account settings; token effective base/project access follows deployed version/roles. No Feishu/Casdoor assumption.
auth.credentialHandling: Private injection only; never print/store secrets in repository, command arguments, chat or receipts. Discovery itself performs no login/token creation.
